recognize_zh: 這是 E4402（RESORT）臨床試驗流程圖（非形態學影像）：先給 rituximab 375 mg/m² 每週一次共 4 劑，達 CR 或 PR 者隨機分為每 3 個月維持治療，或疾病進展時再治療，持續至治療失敗。
features: Induction with rituximab 375 mg/m2 weekly for 4 doses
Patients achieving CR or PR are randomized
Arm 1: rituximab maintenance 375 mg/m2 every 3 months
Arm 2: rituximab re-treatment at progression, 375 mg/m2 weekly for 4 doses
Treatment continues until failure: no response to retreatment or progression within 6 months, need for cytotoxic therapy, or inability to complete therapy
describe_en: This non-morphologic figure shows the schema of the ECOG E4402 (RESORT) trial in low-tumor-burden follicular lymphoma. Patients received rituximab induction at 375 mg/m2 weekly for four doses, and those achieving complete or partial response were randomized to scheduled maintenance rituximab every 3 months or to rituximab re-treatment only at progression, each continued until treatment failure. Treatment failure was defined as no response to retreatment or progression within 6 months of rituximab, initiation of cytotoxic therapy, or inability to complete treatment. The trial found that maintenance did not prolong time to treatment failure compared with re-treatment at progression, supporting the retreatment strategy with less rituximab exposure.
